Mod lets you find your friend in Dark Souls

Personally, I always respected FromSoft's vision when it comes to multiplayer Dark Souls.

They said that they didn't want friends hooking up online and just rolling through the whole game together. It was meant to be an isolated experience. Restoring your humanity was meant to be a risk - you might be invaded by douchebags. Any assistance you receive against bosses is supposed to feel like the random kindness of strangers.

Everyone is struggling through their own version of Lodran, but then there's also the knowledge/camaraderie that other nameless souls are suffering through the same thing as you.

I agree with you, but it's also nice to see mods enabling new ways to play for whomever is interested in them. Half-Life 2 is always intended to be a single player experience, but you can get some more mileage out of it with a co-op mod and a buddy.
